Motilal Oswal Midcap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 29 Dec 2009. Ankit Agarwal is the Current Fund Manager of Motilal Oswal Midcap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹1,59,647 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 30 Oct 2026 is ₹111.44.
